subject: Audit log exportability & residency options for Acme Health
messages:
From: David Sullivan <david.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Audit log exporting & retention questions

Hi Priyom,

We're preparing an internal eDiscovery request and need to understand Redwood's audit/access log export and retention capabilities so we can scope what we ask for in our evidence request. A few specific questions to confirm: 

- What are the default retention windows for audit logs vs access logs on the hosted API? Are there configurable retention tiers (90 days, 1 year, 3 years)?
- For Dedicated/Private deployments — do we support per-account longer retention (e.g., 3+ years) and is that priced separately?
- Export formats and transport: do you provide bulk exports to customer S3 (encrypted), or only syslog streaming and small-event downloads? Can exports be chunked (monthly) and produced as JSON + CSV manifest?
- Residency: can exports be generated with event timestamps normalized to a region (UTC vs client local) and can we request exports to specific region storage (us-east-1 vs eu-west-1)?
- Deletion/legal hold: if we place a legal hold, does that pause scheduled deletions automatically? How do you evidence that deletion has been suppressed for specific time windows?
- Audit trail authenticity: do exported files include checksums/signatures and the export job metadata (who requested, job id, time)?

We may need a sample export of ~12 months of audit events for a single workspace for a legal review. Can you also call out typical SLA for generating that size of export and any known size limits?

Thanks — if easier to hop on a short call I can make time this week.

-David
Security & Compliance, Acme Health

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: David Sullivan <david.sullivan@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-21T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log exporting & retention questions

Hi David — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise summary of what Redwood supports; I included next steps at the bottom and attached our export spec and a manifest template for reference.

Summary of capabilities (short):
- Default retention (Hosted API): audit logs 90 days; access logs 90 days.
- Extended retention: Available for Dedicated and Private customers as an add-on (1 year, 3 years, or custom terms). For Hosted customers we can negotiate retention extensions on a case-by-case basis (requires contract addendum).
- Export transports: bulk exports to customer-owned S3 (server-side encrypted, SSE-KMS supported), SFTP, and streaming via syslog / HTTPS webhook. Bulk exports are produced as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) with a CSV manifest that lists file names, start/end timestamps, counts, and sha256 checksums.
- Chunking: exports are typically chunked by day or month depending on requested range and size (we default monthly for >30 days).
- Residency: exports are written to the requested cloud region where supported (e.g., us-east-1). Event timestamps are preserved in UTC by default; we can provide a region-normalized timestamp field on request.
- Legal hold & deletion: placing a legal hold in the Console pauses automated deletions for the scoped workspace(s). Holds are recorded in the audit trail and export job metadata; deletion tasks will skip held items and the skip reason is logged.
- Evidence & integrity: export manifest includes requester identity (user/email), job id, start/end, record counts, sha256 checksums and a signed export metadata blob (HMAC-SHA256 using our export service key).
- SLA / performance: a 12-month export for a single mid-size workspace (~200GB compressed) typically completes within 24–72 hours on Dedicated; hosted exports of similar size can take 48–120 hours depending on current export queue. If you need faster turnaround we can prioritize via an expedited export (extra fee).
- Limits: individual export files limited to 100GB; total job can span multiple files (manifest describes them).

Next steps / what we need from you:
1) Confirm workspace id / HubSpot account id (send HS id if you have it).
2) Confirm target export destination (S3 bucket with write role ARN) and preferred chunking (monthly vs daily).
3) Legal hold start date (if you want us to preserve records from a specific date forward).

Attachment: redwood-audit-export-specs.pdf (covers formats, sample manifest)
Attachment: redwood-export-manifest-template.csv

If agreeable, I can route an expedited export request to our infra team as soon as you provide the S3 write role and HS id.

Best,
Priyom
Account Lead — Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
[Attachment: redwood-audit-export-specs.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: redwood-export-manifest-template.csv (text/csv)]
